Unique_to_Meteorology: {"object_names": [], "makers": [], "organisations/institutions": ["The Air Ministry"], "dates": ["1922", "1919"], "places": [], "descriptions": ["The object of this instrument is to warn the pilot when a water-cooled engine is in danger of overheating, and whether there is any loss, by boiling, in the water-cooling system.
